fields.summary_ko.0: SpaceX-Tesla merger negotiations are underway with possible announcement in early December, with total transaction value estimated at approximately $3.5 trillion, representing the largest corporate transaction in history.
fields.summary_ko.1: Bank of America analysts expect Tesla shareholders to hold approximately 47% of the company post-merger at a 20% premium; based on Tesla stock price of $393.65 and SpaceX stock price of $140.33.
